original_card.question: Can one known scalar simplification be converted into an actual paid-profile improvement?
methods: Derive the changed legal frame itinerary and exact child histogram.
Prove a scoped obstruction showing why that scalar gain cannot change the paid contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An unchanged histogram is not a kappa gain; record any separate runtime or proof benefit explicitly.

first_step.inspect: Observe that the positive control improves scalar counts while retaining the paid histogram.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one simplification and derive the complete changed frame itinerary, or prove why it cannot change the histogram.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legal change to the histogram, not addition count alone, is the bridge to an exponent gain.
allowed_variations: One existing scalar simplification and one proposed frame-path change.
scope_change_triggers: Submitting only another scalar count as completion of a paid-profile task.

actual_scope: On both pinned PR3734 staged544 providers, price every legal first ADD move that crosses at least two scalar neighbours, at every feasible common-frame dimension, and price every single-ADD continuation after one explicit changed-frame witness.
scope_change_reason: The card allows one frame-path change. This is that change for the PR3942 radius-one contract: the first ADD crosses two or more neighbours and may change frame. It is not an R439 scalar-count reduction, and it does not review the radius-one interaction reduction.
bottleneck_link: A negative raw-moment delta on this frame path would be a paid-histogram change. The certified nonnegative deltas show this path does not supply one. No kappa is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop after the dimension-complete long-first census on both providers and the single-move continuation census of one changed-frame witness. Do not search a second long move or review PROOF.md sections 2-3.
evidence: Exact nonnegative S_j certificates for every long first-move dimension and for every single-move continuation of witness A/595/cut 1214/frame [85].
author: unpaidmoon
ai_assistance: Cursor Grok assisted the census script, packaging, and write-up. The predecessor trace and frame auditor are vendored unchanged.

open_questions.question: After every long first move, not only witness A/595, does every single-ADD continuation stay nonnegative?
open_questions.why_it_matters: One witness does not extend the radius-one theorem to the whole two-neighbour class.
open_questions.first_step: Repeat the continuation census on a long move whose feasible frame interval has quotient rank greater than 1.
open_questions.blocked_by: The pair of censuses is a different budget from this witness.

open_questions.question: Can a second ADD that itself crosses two or more neighbours improve the combined raw moment?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The continuation census uses the single-move corridor, which prices every distance inside that corridor, but a second changed-frame long move can change geometry again.
open_questions.first_step: Freeze one edited word and one second cut that crosses two neighbours, then add the two histograms.
open_questions.blocked_by: No source-bound obstruction for that second long move is claimed here.
